scope: Conditional local ideal-MHD model comparison, not an observational reconstruction
baseline: Prescribed coronal model with a fast+ shock at 750 km/s
unchanged_inputs: LEFT and RIGHT density, velocity, magnetic components; RIGHT pressure; gamma=5/3; pure ionized hydrogen, Te=Tp
provenance: All plasma inputs ASSUMED; inherited values do not become measurements of the new AIA region
branch_method: Warm-started five-parameter regular-fan contact matching using unchanged archived RMO wave curves. This follows one nearby branch and does not enumerate all branches or prove uniqueness.
warm_start: Recovered from the stored baseline intermediate states; baseline recalculated first
normal: Assumed locally along G1; not an observed three-dimensional normal
surface_radius_source: RSUN_REF=6.9600000e8 m in the AIA JP2 FITS header; zero feature height assumed
model_coordinate: Local x along assumed propagation normal, mapped as theta=theta0+x/R onto the existing great circle. This is not a spherical-MHD evolution.
position_anchor: Only the first selected AIA display-change maximum is conditionally associated with the right fast shock; theta0 follows from theta_peak_first-Dfast*tau0/R. theta0 is a local Riemann interface, distinct from the eruption center.
later_frames: No per-frame repositioning. Later peak positions are compared, not used to tune physical speeds.
obliquity_formula: For a locally planar front, speed along the fixed cut is Dnormal/cos(alpha); these are assumed illustrative angles, not confidence limits.
classification_limits: No brightness-to-density inversion, no identified contact or rarefaction, no fitted radiance response, no measured launch time. The source-centered geometry and local initial interface must not be confused.
